player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I scored "Frustration" too high (8) while ignoring the stronger emotional cues of "Helplessness" and "Fear" present in Brenda's final lines ("I just... I don't want you to make the same mistakes I did"). Her tone shifted from anger to a vulnerable, resigned plea, indicating she feels powerless to stop Tessa's rebellion and fears repeating her own past failures. Next time, I will prioritize "Helplessness" and "Fear" as the dominant emotions, assigning them higher scores (e.g., 8-9) and lowering "Frustration" to reflect her exhaustion rather than active anger, while keeping "Acceptance" low as she is not yet accepting Tessa's choices.
